## Core Engineering Services
RexonSoftTech provides end-to-end bespoke technology solutions across seven primary engineering domains:

1. **Custom ERP Software Development**
   - URL: https://rexonsofttech.in/services/erp-development
   - Capabilities: Tailor-made enterprise resource planning systems built for specific manufacturing, trading, and operational workflows. Avoids off-the-shelf licensing constraints and rigid workflows.

2. **Custom Software Development**
   - URL: https://rexonsofttech.in/services/custom-software-development
   - Capabilities: Tailor-made business applications, specialized billing packages, internal management dashboards, operational control systems, and automated data pipelines.

3. **Website Development**
   - URL: https://rexonsofttech.in/services/website-development
   - Capabilities: Fast, SEO-optimized, accessible corporate websites and digital brand platforms engineered with modern Next.js static and server rendering.

4. **Web Application Development**
   - URL: https://rexonsofttech.in/services/web-application-development
   - Capabilities: Multi-tenant cloud portals, internal enterprise web applications, real-time analytics dashboards, and relational database systems.

5. **Mobile Application Development**
   - URL: https://rexonsofttech.in/services/mobile-app-development
   - Capabilities: High-performance iOS and Android applications, cross-platform React Native solutions, offline-first data synchronization, and enterprise field workforce tools.

6. **AI & Business Process Automation**
   - URL: https://rexonsofttech.in/services/ai-automation
   - Capabilities: Intelligent data extraction, automated document and PDF generation, automated customer notifications, workflow orchestration, and predictive business insights.

7. **Cybersecurity & VAPT Services**
   - URL: https://rexonsofttech.in/services/cybersecurity-vapt
   - Capabilities: Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT), OWASP Top 10 security audits, network security verification, cloud infrastructure hardening, and compliance readiness.

## Specialized ERP Systems & Modules
- **Main ERP Solutions Hub:** https://rexonsofttech.in/erp
- **Steel Fabrication ERP:** https://rexonsofttech.in/erp/steel-fabrication
  - Engineered specifically for structural steel, fabrication workshops, CNC machining, cutting optimization, raw material lot tracking, and job-work reconciliation.
- **Multi-Warehouse Inventory Management:** https://rexonsofttech.in/erp/inventory-management
  - Real-time stock visibility across multiple locations, batch and serial tracking, barcode/QR integration, automated reorder thresholds, and bin-level allocations.
- **GST Billing & E-Invoicing Engine:** https://rexonsofttech.in/erp/gst-billing
  - Automated GST-compliant tax calculation, direct NIC portal e-invoice generation, e-way bill generation, audit trails, and multi-format commercial invoice printing.

## Technical Stack & Architectural Standards
- **Frontend & App Frameworks:** Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- **Backend & Cloud Architecture:** Node.js, RESTful microservices, Cloudflare Edge Network, PostgreSQL
- **Security Standards:** Strict Content Security Policy (CSP), HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS), X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, OWASP compliance
